references.text: The next verse continues the description of the gathering and shows that those who gathered much and those who gathered little all had enough - an omer per person.
The Lord gave instructions for the people to go out and gather manna each day, which the children of Israel obey here.
The Lord's command to gather manna according to each person's need, which the children of Israel follow here.
Describes how the people gathered and prepared the manna, a parallel to the gathering described in Exodus.
The manna ceased when the children of Israel entered the land of Canaan and ate from the produce of the land, ending the period of manna that began with this gathering.
Paul quotes from Exodus 16:18 in his teaching on generosity, pointing to the principle that whoever gathered much had nothing left over, and whoever gathered little had no lack.
Both verses emphasize the total obedience of the Israelites as they carry out God's specific commands.
